verdict.rationale: Fastmail has its own calendar, and a help article titled "Calendar events and invitations" points to event and invite handling. Community users mention a Fastmail calendar UI and calendar ingestion. But the pack has only article titles and passing mentions, so the in-client flows the story asks for are not described. missing for 10: documented content showing the calendar viewed inside the mail client, RSVP to invites directly from messages, event creation steps, and hands-on corroboration of these flows.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: Gmail integration for ingesting mail and calendars works fantastically.
you can add your Fastmail calendar to Google Calendar
